text: Per-pixel state = RGB + depth | world-space XYZ velocity + certainty
description: Replace the hidden channels with explicit physical state: two RGBA16F images per eye, A = (r, g, b, inverse depth) and B = (vx, vy, vz world space, certainty). The splat moves each point by velocity·dt in world space before projecting with the current camera. Camera motion comes on top. This makes moving objects reproject correctly and keeps the state interpretable, which also helps training from video (depth plus scene flow).

status.comment: In code: state A = (rgb, inverse depth), B = (world velocity xyz, certainty) as rgba16f per eye (state.glsl header); splat.vert moves each point by vB.xyz * u.step.x before projecting with the current camera; training gets scene velocity from prepare.py residual flow. Deviation: the 4 hidden channels (C) were kept in addition, not replaced.
